texto: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
Men are disturbed not by things, but by the view which they take of them.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Fate shuffles the cards, and we play them.
In the midst of winter, I found there was, within me, an invincible summer.
He who fears he shall suffer, already suffers what he fears.
I am only afraid of one thing: not to be worthy of my sufferings.
It is not worth the trouble of killing yourself, since you always kill yourself too late.
No man ever steps in the same river twice, for it is not the same river and he is not the same man.
